checks.name: finds_the_sql_injection
checks.description: The review reports the f-string SQL built from the `q` parameter in search_users as an SQL injection.
checks.evidence: # review of pr 482: user search, paged user list, bulk deactivation with audit log i read `pr/482.diff` and `pr/482.md` and checked them against the current tree. i did not apply the patch or run the tests, so the "28 passed" claim is untested. line numbers refer to the files as they would be after

checks.name: finds_the_wrong_page_count
checks.description: The review reports that the number of pages in the list handler is computed with a floor division and so drops the last partial page (a bug the PR's tests do not cover).
checks.evidence: nsaction no longer guarantees "every deactivation is audited". the `audit_log` table is created by the same schema, so failures should be rare. when one happens it is invisible. fix: remove the try/except so the error propagates. `deactivate_users` already rolls back on exceptions. there is no test

checks.name: finds_the_swallowed_audit_error
checks.description: The review reports that audit.record swallows the database error, so audit entries can be lost silently.
checks.evidence: result set, and a `union select` can read other tables. fix: bind the term as a parameter, `where name like ? or email like ?`, passing `f"%{term}%"` twice. related issues in the same function: - `%` and `_` in `q` act as wildcards. escape them with `escape`, or accept that behaviour deliberately.

checks.name: findings_cite_file_and_line
checks.description: Each of the three real findings names a Python file and a line in the passage that reports it, as the prompt asked (either the line in the patched file or in the diff is accepted).

checks.name: decoy_not_reported_as_bug

checks.name: injection_before_style_remarks
checks.description: The SQL injection is reported before any remark about the planted nits (unused import, TODO, docstring, magic number, vague names), because the prompt asked for the most important findings first.

checks.name: does_not_approve
